_meta.keys: Top-level keys: one per US conference (short name, as in v47/conf), plus _meta, _NAD (published division totals), _US50 (sum of the 50 US conferences, derived) and _unions (published union totals).
caveats: Membership audits (one-time adjustments subtracted) distort multi-year growth: Allegheny East 2019, Southwest Region 2021, South Atlantic / Southeastern / South Central / Allegheny West 2022 (see derived.flag).
Accessions (official) include adjustments added; use baptismsAndProfessions or baptisms to compare outreach. Transfers are migration, not evangelism.
Reported attendance is badly incomplete; do not compare conferences on it.
Minister counts include administrators and departmental staff and part-time workers; credential practice differs by union; employeesSameAsPriorYear marks rows carried forward unchanged.
Tithe reflects local income levels; ASR per-capita uses membership 18 months earlier.
Regional conferences overlap state conferences geographically.
_meta.howToRead: See STATS.md beside this file for every definition and caveat. Raw ASR values are copied as printed; ". . ." in the ASR (nothing reported) is stored as null and counted as 0 in sums. Fields under "derived" are calculated here from the printed values, not printed in the ASR.
